items.title: MURKY WATER
items.subtitle: Reef-Themed Deck
items.art: green/turquoise murky sea scene, large shark in lower right, distant blurred fish on left
items.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create one polished photorealistic e-commerce product photo of an assembled compact upright SeaRealm MURKY WATER trading card tuck box.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is the EXACT front-panel print artwork, image 2 is the EXACT right-side-panel print artwork, image 3 is the EXACT top-panel print artwork. Apply these supplied panels faithfully as print textures to the corresponding planes of a real assembled box. Do not redesign, re-illustrate, change the typography, change the layout, or rewrite any label. Retain every source character, trademark symbol, exact stylized SeaRealm script logo and blue waves, colors, artwork, relative sizes and positions. Front artwork includes green/turquoise murky sea scene, large shark in lower right, distant blurred fish on left. Front printed text verbatim: "SeaRealm™", "Have You Walked in the Recesses of the Deep?", "MURKY WATER™", "Reef-Themed Deck". Side uses the supplied rotated vertical logo and "MURKY WATER™". Top uses the supplied "SeaRealm™" and "TRADING CARD GAME".
Object geometry: closed, neat compact printed paperboard tuck box, front physical aspect ratio 826 wide by 1088 tall, depth 337.5 relative to front width 826. Accurately fold the three planes into the closed box; crisp straight folds, subtle paper thickness, discreet tuck lid seam, no visible unfolded tabs.
Camera/composition: single fully uncropped upright box centered; front dominant, narrow RIGHT side visible, only slight top visible. Camera about 10–15 degrees elevated, moderate 20–25 degree horizontal view from right. Front should take about 80–85% of visible box width. Keep vertical edges nearly vertical, modest natural perspective, commercial 85mm product lens. Match the same camera, scale and alignment of a product catalog set. 4:3 landscape canvas around 2000 by 1500 pixels; product occupies about 75% of canvas height with generous empty space.
Material/light: realistic matte/satin printed cardstock; clean smooth fine paper texture, no plastic wrapping; soft diffuse upper-left studio light, mild edge highlights, very subtle natural contact shadow immediately beneath the base.
BACKGROUND: genuinely transparent alpha background. No opaque white, no checkerboard drawn into image, no scene. Preserve alpha. Only product and its delicate contact shadow.
Avoid props, extra boxes, extra captions, invented labels, watermarks, dimension lines, measurements, die lines, cut guides, crop marks, floating panels, large open flaps, or changing the marine illustrations. Fidelity to the three supplied print panels is the highest priority.
